about.title: About Çiçekli Game Dev
about.subtitle: We are a group of passionate game developers, designers, and artists building the future of gaming.
about.missionPara1: Founded in 2025, Çiçekli Game Dev began when two friends joined a game jam. Today, it has grown into a vibrant and dedicated community focused on mastering the craft of game development.
about.missionPara2: We believe in learning by doing. That’s why we organize weekly lessons, monthly workshops, and game jams. Our goal is to provide a safe and supportive environment where members can experiment, fail, and succeed together.
about.value1Desc: We support each other. No question is too simple, no mistake too complex. We grow together.
about.value2Desc: We take pride in our code and art. We strive for excellence in every pixel and every line of code.
about.value3Desc: We encourage exploring new ideas and experimenting. Growth happens when we dare to think differently.
